short: ' you' after if / when in instructions
notes: Probes: 'or if you' 1.09 whichever word followed, sentence-initial 'If you' 0.06-0.16, so being mid-text seems to matter. The output direction is about absence (the - pole fires on what is lacking), which this label does not test.
